inputs.headline: Wondering Whether Your Roof Is Ready?
inputs.message:
Unsure if your roof can take solar? Free site survey first, plus PM Surya Ghar subsidy help from our team.
Message Solaride on WhatsApp to book your free site survey.
inputs.description: Solaride checks your roof before any work starts.

whatsappGreeting.autofill: Namaste! Mujhe Solaride ke Free site survey aur PM Surya Ghar subsidy help ke baare mein jaankari chahiye.
whatsappGreeting.greeting: Namaste! Solaride mein aapka swagat hai. Apna sawaal yahan likhiye.
